meta.promptText: Which face wash should I buy for oily skin in India under ₹500?

response.text:
If you have **oily skin**, my top pick under ₹500 is:

### [Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Cleanser]()
*₹269*

### My picks

1. **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Cleanser — ~₹269–₹285**  
   **Best overall** if you have oily skin, blackheads, clogged pores, or occasional pimples. It combines 2% salicylic acid + LHA and is fragrance-free/non-comedogenic. [beminimalist.co](https://beminimalist.co/products/salicylic-lha-2-cleanser?_pos=9&_sid=5c40da511&_ss=r&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

2. **Simple Kind to Skin Refreshing Facial Wash — ~₹184**  
   **Best if your skin is oily but sensitive.** It's a gentler everyday cleanser without fragrance or colour. [www.ndtvshopping.com](https://www.ndtvshopping.com/beauty-and-grooming/best-face-washes-to-buy-for-indian-skin-oily-dry-dull-and-acne-10899929?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### [Simple Kind To Skin Refreshing Facial Wash]()
*₹184*

### [Chemist At Play Oil & Acne Control Face Wash]()
*₹239*

### [Cetaphil Oily Skin Cleanser 59 ml]()
*₹389*

3. **Cetaphil Oily Skin Cleanser — ~₹389 for 59 ml**  
   A good gentler option, although the larger sizes can exceed ₹500. 

**What I'd buy:**  
- 🧴 **Very oily/acne-prone:** Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid  
- 🌿 **Oily + sensitive:** Simple Refreshing Facial Wash  
- 💧 **Oily but easily irritated:** Cetaphil Oily Skin Cleanser

If you're **under 18**, I'd lean toward Simple rather than starting with a 2% salicylic-acid cleanser; Minimalist lists its salicylic cleanser as suitable for 15+. [beminimalist.co](https://beminimalist.co/products/salicylic-lha-2-cleanser?_pos=9&_sid=5c40da511&_ss=r&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Prices can vary by seller and offers.
